title: Returns Desk Guidance: Parking Rent Re-Collected by a Catch-Up Draft under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization
content:
**Guidance.** On a Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement drafted under the Bluegate AutoPay Authorization, the parking rent the catch-up re-collects is:

- **nothing**, while the returned entry may still be presented again, that is while fewer settled draft attempts than one plus the method's number of re-presentments are recorded for the returned parking due date, because the next presentment collects it;
- **the parking rent charge less the direct payments** taken at a facility office, by phone or online after the same calendar day of the previous month and up to the handling date, where such payments exist;
- **otherwise, the whole parking rent charge.**

Settled draft attempts are the draft attempts on the authorization for the returned parking due date (the parking agreement's oldest unpaid due date) whose result is ACH settled. Direct payments are payments on the parking ledger taken through the facility office, care center phone or online portal channels, dated after the same calendar day of the previous month and up to the handling date; payment reversals are not netted against them.

| Method | Re-presentments of one returned entry | Settled attempts at which the entry may not be presented again |
|---|---|---|
| Debit Card | 0 | not a bank method |
| Credit Card | 0 | not a bank method |
| Personal Checking ACH | 1 | 2 |
| Personal Savings ACH | 1 | 2 |
| Business Checking ACH | 2 | 3 |
| Business Card | 0 | not a bank method |

**Cases (hypothetical, Business Checking ACH, parking rent charge $140.00, handling date 20 June).**

| Settled attempts for the returned due date | Direct payments dated 21 May to 20 June | Rent re-collected |
|---|---|---|
| 2 | — | Nothing — one re-presentment remains |
| 3 | none | $140.00 |
| 3 | $55.00 at the facility office | $85.00 |
| 3 | $55.00 dated 20 May | $140.00 — outside the window |

On the two personal bank methods, which allow one re-presentment, 2 settled attempts already mean the entry may not be presented again.
